sloka: आहूय सो ऽङ्गदं कोपात् ताडयामास वेगितः।गदया कम्पनः पूर्वं स चचाल भृशाहतः ।। ६.७६.२ ।।
transliteration: āhūya so 'ṅgadaṁ kopāt tāḍayāmāsa vegitaḥ।gadayā kampanaḥ pūrvaṁ sa cacāla bhṛśāhataḥ ।। 6.76.2 ।।

translations.english: Kampana struck Angada challenging himin anticipation. He swiftly hurled a mace in anger and hurt him grievously and Angada reeled.
